dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCGI01 handles hospital admission/discharge registration (入退院登録).
evidence: fixed format with Japanese EUC comments

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical receipt (レセプト) system - hospital admission and discharge registration module for JMA ORCA standard receipt software
purpose.summary: ORCGI01 is the admission/discharge registration component (入退院登録 I01) of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles patient admission and discharge processing including fee calculation, insurance combination checks, ward/room management, and various special admission fee types under Japanese national health insurance rules. The program has been extensively revised from 2002 through 2014 to accommodate Japanese health insurance regulation changes.

notable_features: 106 COPY statements indicating heavy use of copybooks
1559 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but contains Japanese EUC (Extended Unix Code) encoded text in comments - the garbled characters are Japanese. This is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system used widely in Japanese medical clinics. The program is very large and production-quality with a detailed change log. Source was truncated to 16000 chars but the structure and purpose are clear from the header and data division.
